name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.

Beatrix's levy is immediately below the artisan who makes Boots.
The Potter's levy is at least 4 coins more than the artisan in Highrow.
4 coins goes with exactly three of Rowan, Cooper, Boots, and Southgate.
